g.text: Flight / Airline Reservation System — Class Diagram
Seat and AirCraft are declared in the same header (AirCraft.h) but modeled as two separate classes
+ Passenger(Passenger_id, name, password, email, age, Credit)
+ Flight(flight_number, origin, destination, dep_time, arr_time, aircraft, status, price)
+ Reservation(reservation_id, passenger, flight, seat_id, payment, status = "Waitlisted")
+ Save_User(name, password, email, age, id) : bool
+ Save_Passenger(name, password, email, age, id, credit) : bool
+ Save_Aircraft(aircraft_id, type, capacity, status = true) : bool
+ Save_Flight(flight_number, origin, destination, dep, arr, aircraft_id, status, price) : bool
+ Save_Reservation(reservation_id, passenger_id, flight_number, seat_id, payment_id, status) : bool
+ createStaffUser(admin_id, role, name, password, email, age) : bool
+ addAircraft(admin_id, aircraft_id, type, capacity, status = true) : bool
+ scheduleFlight(admin_id, flight_number, origin, destination, dep, arr, aircraft_id, price) : bool
